title: Local Information: parent feature checkboxes gate their percentage input but NOT their 'calculate on net amount' / 'show as administrative fee' modifier siblings — an orphaned modifier can be ticked and saved while its parent feature is off, and the inconsistent state persists
requirementSource: Location Settings -> Local Information sub-tab (/navigator/locations/<office>/settings/location). The parent-enables-children pattern is the established contract on this form and the app already implements half of it correctly: unchecking Apply LDW disables AND zeroes the LDW Percentage input. Archetype ARCH-005 'parent-checkbox-doesnt-disable-children' in specs_planning/_internal/bug-archetypes.md defines the sibling-modifier subtype as a file-on-reproduction defect, and names these exact three groups as the systemic instance first recorded as BUG-LI-002 (Service Charge group, 2026-04-27) and BUG-LI-003 (LDW + C&C groups, 2026-04-28).
stepsToReproduce: Navigate to https://cloudapps-e2e.encoreglobal.com/navigator/locations/1606/settings/location and click the 'Local Information' sub-tab.

Observe the Service Charge group at rest: 'Service Charge' (location-settings-checkbox-allow-service-charge) is UNCHECKED, yet both 'Show Service Charge As Administrative Fee' (location-settings-checkbox-is-administrative-fee) and 'Calculate Service Charge On Net Amount' (location-settings-checkbox-calc-service-charge-on-net) are ENABLED and freely clickable.

Observe the Cables & Consumables group at rest: 'Apply Cables and Consumables Fee' (location-settings-checkbox-apply-cables-consumables) is UNCHECKED; its 'C&C Percentage' input is correctly DISABLED, but the sibling 'Calculate C&C on Net Amount' (location-settings-checkbox-calc-cac-on-net-amount) is ENABLED.

Now demonstrate the persisted-inconsistency on the LDW group. Confirm 'Apply LDW' (location-settings-checkbox-apply-ldw) is CHECKED and 'Calculate LDW on Net Amount' (location-settings-checkbox-calc-ldw-on-net-amount) is unchecked.
Click 'Apply LDW' to switch it OFF. Observe the LDW Percentage input correctly disables and resets to 0.00% — the percentage child IS gated.
Observe that 'Calculate LDW on Net Amount' remains ENABLED even though its parent feature is now off.
Click 'Calculate LDW on Net Amount' to tick it ON. It accepts the click and reads aria-checked=true, and the Save button enables.
Click Save and confirm the 'Save Changes' dialog with Ok. The save succeeds (PUT /navigator/api/location/update-properties).
Reload the page and reopen the Local Information sub-tab.
Observe the persisted inconsistent state: Apply LDW = false while Calculate LDW on Net Amount = true — a modifier for a feature that is switched off has been stored against the location.
expectedBehavior: A parent feature checkbox should gate every control in its group, not just the percentage input. When Apply LDW / Apply Cables and Consumables Fee / Service Charge is unchecked, its modifier siblings ('Calculate ... on Net Amount', 'Show Service Charge As Administrative Fee') should be disabled — and, consistent with how the percentage inputs already behave, reset — so that the form cannot express or persist a modifier for a disabled feature.
actualBehavior: Only the percentage input is gated. The modifier sibling checkboxes stay enabled and interactive with their parent off, across all three groups (LDW, Cables & Consumables, Service Charge). On the LDW group this was driven end to end: with Apply LDW switched off, Calculate LDW on Net Amount was ticked, the Save button enabled, the save was accepted by the server, and after a full page reload the location still reads Apply LDW = false with Calculate LDW on Net Amount = true. The application therefore both allows and durably stores a logically inconsistent configuration.

mcpEvidence.findings: Live authenticated Playwright walk (headless, .auth/encore-state.json) against office 1606. At-rest read of all three groups: allow-service-charge {checked:false, disabled:false} with is-administrative-fee {checked:false, disabled:false} and calc-service-charge-on-net {checked:false, disabled:false}; apply-cables-consumables {checked:false, disabled:false} with cables-consumables-percentage input {value:'0.00%', disabled:TRUE} but calc-cac-on-net-amount {checked:false, disabled:FALSE}; apply-ldw {checked:true} with default-ldw-percentage {value:'4.00%', disabled:false}. After clicking apply-ldw off: default-ldw-percentage became {value:'0.00%', disabled:TRUE} (correct gating) while calc-ldw-on-net-amount stayed {disabled:FALSE}; a click on that orphaned sibling succeeded with no error and flipped it to aria-checked=true, and the Save button became enabled. Save was confirmed through the 'Save Changes / Are you sure you want to save the changes? / Cancel / Ok' dialog and fired PUT /navigator/api/location/update-properties. After a full reload the state read back as apply-ldw {checked:false} + calc-ldw-on-net-amount {checked:true} — the probe recorded INCONSISTENT_STATE_PERSISTED=true. The office was then restored in the same run and re-verified by reload: apply-ldw checked=true, calc-ldw-on-net-amount checked=false, LDW Percentage '4.00%' — office 1606 is back at its documented baseline with no residue.

baselineEvidence: BASELINE WALKED 2026-09-21 — RESULT: NOT A REGRESSION. The legacy Navigator site (navigator2.training.psav.com) was authenticated via shared SSO and office 1604 opened at #/setup/locationdetail/1604 (the legacy baseline entity per LR-ENC-001; office 1606 does not exist there). Observation-only: form controls were toggled to read gating state and Save was NEVER clicked. Legacy at rest: ldwid(Apply LDW)=checked/enabled, CAL_LDW_ID(Calculate LDW on Net Amount)=unchecked/ENABLED, SC_ID(Service Charge)=checked/enabled, AdminFeeId=unchecked/ENABLED, SCOnNetAmtId=unchecked/ENABLED. Toggling ldwid OFF left CAL_LDW_ID at disabled=false. Toggling SC_ID OFF left BOTH AdminFeeId and SCOnNetAmtId at disabled=false. The legacy site therefore exhibits the IDENTICAL non-gating behaviour as cloudapps-e2e: modifier siblings stay live when their parent feature is off, on both sites. This is long-standing pre-existing behaviour, NOT something the new site introduced. Classified intentional-UX-change as the closest LR-034 enum value meaning 'divergence is not a regression' — strictly there is NO divergence at all, the two sites match. TRIAGE NOTE: the defect stands on its own merits as a data-integrity concern (the new site was proven to persist Apply LDW=false + Calculate LDW on Net Amount=true across a reload), but the client may reasonably triage it as by-design given it has behaved this way on both generations of the product. What was NOT tested on legacy: whether legacy also PERSISTS the inconsistent combination, since saving on the shared legacy office was out of bounds.
networkEvidence: The orphaned-modifier save was accepted by the server, not blocked on the client: the Save click fired PUT https://cloudapps-e2e.encoreglobal.com/navigator/api/location/update-properties and the value survived a subsequent full page load, proving server-side persistence rather than a client-only UI artefact. The restore save fired the same endpoint and likewise round-tripped. This contrasts with BUG-LOC-LI-001 on the same screen, where an invalid form produced zero requests — here the inconsistent state is not merely accepted by the UI, it reaches and is stored by the backend.

verificationLog.evidence: The observation itself (parent off + modifier on saves and survives a reload) is reproducible and unchanged. But the legacy site behaves identically, so nothing regressed, and no downstream mis-pricing has been demonstrated — only inferred. Severity lowered to low pending a product decision on whether the orphaned flag is honoured anywhere. Close as by-design if it is not.
